claims.statement: Mary Barra was named CEO of General Motors in 2013, at age 52.

citations.quote: When 52-year-old Mary Barra was named CEO of General Motors in 2013

claims.statement: Barra began her career as a rare female electrical engineer and is the daughter of a General Motors die maker; she spent more than thirty years building her career before becoming the first woman to lead a global automaker.

fact.value: Electrical engineer and daughter of a GM die maker; spent more than thirty years at GM before becoming CEO; first woman to lead a global automaker.

citations.quote: Beginning as a rare female electrical engineer and daughter of a General Motors die maker, Barra spent more than thirty years building her career before becoming the first woman to ever lead a global automaker.

claims.statement: Her GM career included working on the factory floor, overseeing manufacturing, improving union relations, paring down bureaucracy, running human resources, and helping the company recover from its 2009 bankruptcy.

fact.value: Career spanning factory floor work, manufacturing oversight, union relations, HR leadership, and post-2009-bankruptcy recovery at GM.

citations.quote: She had done everything from working on the factory floor to overseeing manufacturing, from improving union relations to paring down bureaucracy, and from running human resources to helping drag the company back from its 2009 bankruptcy.

claims.statement: GM had $155 billion in sales and 200,000 employees, and is widely considered a proxy for the U.S. economy.

citations.quote: With $155 billion in sales and 200,000 employees, GM is widely considered to be a proxy for the U.S. economy, making Barra's position arguably the most important corporate role a woman has ever held.

claims.statement: The book argues Barra's willingness to take on diverse assignments helped steer her career trajectory.

fact.value: Willingness to take on diverse assignments is described as steering her career trajectory.

citations.quote: Learn how Mary Barra's willingness to take on diverse assignments helped steer her career trajectory

claims.statement: The book examines Barra's management style and her ability to relate to colleagues.

fact.value: Management style and ability to relate to colleagues.

citations.quote: Examine the fine details of Barra's management style and her ability to relate to colleagues
